title: SharePoint: Copilot in SharePoint, with advanced work billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing is incorrectly marked cancelled and archived even though the authoritative roadmap record says Launched. The cited controls and mixed licensing model are documented; several smaller wording and documentation-conflict findings also need correction.
